Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 13-Jun-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JUNE 2025  
  SUBJECT: CHM 1071/CHM_1071 - ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY  
  (MAKE-UP)  
  ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY [CHM 1071-CHM]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                i) Explain the construction and working of calomel electrode. Write any two disadvantages of it.       (4)  
  ii) Write any two differences between galvanic and electrolytic cells.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
1B)                i) A galvanic cell consists of iron plate immersed in 1.5 M FeSO4 solution and copper plate            (4)  
  immersed in 15 M solution of CuSO4 at 298 K. If Eo cell = 1.56 V. Write the cell reaction, cell  
  representation and calculate the EMF of the cell.  
  ii) Give reason: Salt bridge is used in the construction of an electrochemical cell.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1C)                Give reasons for the following:                                                                        (2)  
  i) Oxidant must be free from traces of CO2 in AFC.  
  ii) Weston cadmium cell is used for emf measurements.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2A)                i) A solution of Tryptophan has an absorbance at 280 nm of 0.54 in a 0.5 cm length cuvette. Given      (4)  
  the absorbance coefficient of tryptophan is 6.4 × 10³ Lmol-1 cm-1. What is the concentration of  
  solution?  
  ii) Explain the conductometric titration of strong acid Vs strong base with illustration.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2B)                i) Explain the desalination of brackish water using electrodialysis method.                            (4)  
  ii) Write any two ways by which priming can be avoided in a boiler.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2C)                Discuss any two methods of removal of scales.                                                          (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3A)                Mention any two distinguishing features between the following:                                         (4)  
  i) Cathodic and anodic protection methods of preventing corrosion.  
  ii) Galvanization and tinning.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  Page 1 of 3

3B)              Explain the phenomenon of caustic embrittlement in steel with relevant chemical reactions. Mention (4)  
  two methods of preventing it.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3C)              Explain the effect of the following factors on the rate of corrosion.                                    (2)  
  i) Nature of corrosion product  
  ii) Temperature.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4A)              i) How does the molecular weight of a polymer affect the glass transition temperature?                   (4)  
  ii) A polymer sample has the following composition:  
  $$25 molecules of molecular mass each = 45,000$$  
  $$20 molecules of molecular mass each = 20,000$$  
  $$5 molecules of molecular mass each = 25,000$$  
  Calculate its number-average, weight-average molecular mass and polydispersity index of the  
  polymer.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4B)              i) List the classification of liquid crystals based on shape.                                            (4)  
  ii) Describe the working principle of liquid crystal display in detail.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4C)              Explain the role of the matrix and the dispersed phase in composites.                                    (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5A)              i) The emf of the cell reaction Cd + 2AgCl → CdCl2 .5/2 H2 O +2Ag is 0.6753 V and 0.6915 V at 298 (4)  
  K and 273 K. Calculate ΔH and ΔG at 298 K.  
  ii) Explain the electroless plating of copper with suitable reactions.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5B)              i) What are thin films? Write two differences between PVD and CVD techniques of obtaining thin           (4)  
  films.  
  ii) How are polymers classified based on structure and tacticity.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5C)              i) Give reason: Corrosion is accelerated by deposition of dust or impurities in the crevices.            (2)  
  ii) Differentiate: Electrochemical series from Galvanic series.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  
  -----End-----
